steps.why_en: Identification works, but from a settings file, not the maintained table.
steps.why_id: Pengenalan jalan, tapi dari file setting, bukan tabel kelolaan.

steps.en: Military notices go straight to Reminder 1
Diplomat notices enter Reminder 1 after the LTA result
steps.id: Notice diplomat masuk Reminder 1 setelah hasil LTA
steps.why_en: It depends on a flag in the LTA reply, not on the vehicle number rule.
steps.why_id: Bergantung flag di balasan LTA, bukan aturan nomor kendaraan.

steps.en: Reminder 1 letter is produced and sent to the owner
steps.id: Surat Reminder 1 dibuat dan dikirim ke pemilik
steps.why_en: Letters only run on manual trigger and the upload to the printer is blocked in settings.
steps.why_id: Surat hanya jalan lewat trigger manual dan upload ke percetakan diblok di setting.

steps.en: After 14 days Reminder 2 is produced and sent
steps.id: Setelah 14 hari Reminder 2 dibuat dan dikirim
steps.why_en: Same limits as Reminder 1: manual trigger only and printer upload blocked.
steps.why_id: Batas sama dengan Reminder 1: hanya trigger manual dan upload percetakan diblok.

steps.why_en: The stop exists but only runs inside the manually triggered letter run.
steps.why_id: Berhentinya ada, tapi hanya jalan di proses surat yang dipicu manual.
